info.cls_ename: Master Program of Space System Engineering

description.describe_ch: 本課程將介紹火箭推進的基本原理、設計和操作。學生將學習到火箭發動機的各種推進系統、燃燒室設計、推進劑選擇、性能分析等相關知識。此外，課程還將深入探討火箭推進器的穩定性、控制和導引系統。通過理論教學和實踐項目，學生將獲得在火箭推進領域中設計、分析和優化火箭系統的能力。
description.describe_eh: Human Factors Engineering is a discipline that studies human behavior, cognition, and capabilities in relation to design. This course aims to develop students' ability to consider human factors in space mission and system design. Students will learn the theories and methods of human factors engineering and understand the adaptability and limitations of humans in space environments. The course covers topics such as human-machine interface design, workload assessment, human error and error prevention, operator training, and space flight safety.
